source.author: verg
source.text: At trepida, et coeptis immanibus effera Dido, sanguineam volvens aciem, maculisque trementis interfusa genas, et pallida morte futura, interiora domus irrumpit limina, et altos conscendit furibunda rogos, ensemque recludit Dardanium, non hos quaesitum munus in usus.
source.text_original: At trepida, et coeptis immanibus effera Dido, / sanguineam volvens aciem, maculisque trementis / interfusa genas, et pallida morte futura, / interiora domus irrumpit limina, et altos / conscendit furibunda rogos, ensemque recludit / Dardanium, non hos quaesitum munus in usus.
source.text_english: But Dido, frantic and wild with her monstrous undertaking, rolling her bloodshot gaze, her cheeks streaked with quivering spots, and pale with her coming death, breaks into the inner threshold of the house and, in madness, climbs the high pyre, and draws forth the Dardanian sword, a gift not sought for such purposes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at frater magnos Lynceus servatur in usus, quem tulit Arene, possit qui rumpere terras et Styga transmisso tacitam deprendere visu.
reuse.text_original: at frater magnos Lynceus servatur in usus, / quem tulit Arene, possit qui rumpere terras / et Styga transmisso tacitam deprendere visu.
reuse.text_english: but their brother Lynceus is preserved for great uses, whom Arene bore, who can split the earth and, with his sight sent across, detect silent Styx.
